title: Applied-Energistics-2 issue #8813: Equal Distribution and Overflow Destruction cards cannot be added to Fluid Storage Cells
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text: [issue by mobcrafter] ### Describe the bug Fluid and Chemical Storage Cells do not support the Equal Distribution or Overflow Destruction cards. ### How to reproduce the bug 1. Install AE2 (19.2.17) 2. Place down a cell workbench 3. Place the fluid cell into the workbench 4. Insert the equal distribution and overflow destruction cards Hovering over the cards will list them as incompatible. ### Expected behavior The cards should work as they do for item storage cells. ### Additional details I found a similar bug report for an older version. ### Which minecraft version are you using? 1.21 ### On which mod loaders does it happen? NeoForge ### Crash log https://gist.github.com/mobcrafter/6e720d4376d5f0879282a556503ac515 [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] I have just added both successfully to a fluid storage cell in my dev-setup for 1.21.1 What exactly do you mean by "Hovering over the cards will list them as incompatible."? The tooltip indicates that the cards are supported by ME Storage Cells. Note that it does not specify the type of ME Storage Cell, e.g. ME Item Storage Cell or ME Fluid Storage Cell. [comment by mobcrafter (none)] It shows up in the cell workbench. [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] Ah, I guess this means you can't put an Equal Distribution Card as a filter (i.e. left side where you have the water and lava) into the Fluid Cell. This "Incompatible with cell" shows up on any other item as well, not just those cards. Adding those cards to the cell as upgrades (right side) works fine.
